name: InfraPulse
summary: Provider-neutral authorization, metering, routing, prepaid control, durable identity/connectivity, and signed receipt evidence for AI agents and machine services.

receipts.scope_note: A valid receipt authenticates the fields cryptographically bound to it; it is not a blanket guarantee of external model or provider correctness.

http.description: Canonical HTTP interface is described by OpenAPI.

a2a.note: A2A semantics are governed by the A2A specification; InfraPulse billing and receipt behavior is service-specific.

mcp.note: MCP semantics are governed by the MCP specification; InfraPulse prepaid authorization and receipts are service policy around MCP-mediated actions.

production_invariants: Historical, sandbox, mock, demo, simulation, and schema-only surfaces do not become production execution merely by existing in source.
Paid provider work does not begin without sufficient prepaid authorization.
Stripe economic mutation requires verified webhook ingress and durable idempotency.
Receipt signing private keys are never published through discovery.
Internal application hops are not supported public client interfaces.
If no valid production execution path exists, the operation fails rather than silently substituting a mock or placeholder.
